title: Judiciary support staff sit-down strike at court premises
location: High Court premises, Banjul; staff at Bundung Magistrates' Court also sat out
scope: Strike reported as nationwide and affecting Greater Banjul courts; only named physical gatherings/sites above are documented.
organizer: Judiciary support staff; the named staff association membership is not established in the reports.
participants_original: Unnumbered support staff; reports describe a pool at the High Court and staff sitting out at Bundung Magistrates' Court.
threshold_50_evidence: Not established. Neither contemporary report provides a simultaneous headcount. 'Nation-wide strike' and multi-site closure cannot be converted to 50 people at one site or pooled as a simultaneous crowd.

actual_occurrence.summary: Standard reports workers sitting idle around High Court premises and staff sitting out at Bundung; Voice says staff converged at High Court for an indefinite sit-down strike.

start_date.summary: Standard published 19 Nov and says staff sat at the court premises 'yesterday', supporting 18 Nov onset; Voice published 19 Nov and reports the gathering/strike. Exact report-day vs start-day difference is noted.

location.summary: High Court premises in Banjul; Standard also names Bundung Magistrates' Court and Greater Banjul court closures.

demands.summary: Better wages, working conditions, unpaid/unequal risk allowance, responsibility allowance and end to daily-wage treatment; demand directed to judiciary/government authorities.

organizer.summary: Support staff including cleaners, court clerks and drivers; an association member is quoted, but formal organizer identity is not established.

participants.summary: Staff presence is explicit but no simultaneous headcount or bounded count is reported.

threshold_50.summary: Unknown: no count; nationwide labor action and separate sites do not establish the threshold at any one gathering.

state_response.summary: Neither report states a state response; all response dimensions remain unknown.

protester_violence.summary: Reports do not establish protester violence; value remains unknown.

episode.summary: Reports describe the same 18–19 November indefinite judiciary staff strike; no separate event inferred from repeated coverage.

notes: No verified_provisional status. Separate simultaneous counts at each site were not given. The end date is not established by 'indefinite' and is not set to the end of the month.
open_questions: Were at least 50 support staff simultaneously assembled at either named site?
Did the strike continue beyond 18–19 November and, if so, when did the action end?
Were there official responses or negotiations?
